description: Unit test class for IndexV1Verifier, testing signature verification and error handling in the org.fdroid.index.v1 package.

classes.name: IndexV1VerifierTest
classes.description: Test suite for IndexV1Verifier class, covering various verification scenarios.

methods.name: testNoCertWithFingerprint
methods.description: Tests that providing a fingerprint without a certificate throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: testValid
methods.description: Verifies that a valid jar file passes verification and returns the expected certificate.

methods.name: testValidWrongFingerprint
methods.description: Ensures verification fails with a SigningException when fingerprint does not match.

methods.name: testValidWithExpectedCertificate
methods.description: Verifies that providing an expected certificate passes verification.

methods.name: testValidWithWrongCertificate
methods.description: Checks that verification fails with a SigningException when the certificate does not match.

methods.name: testUnsigned
methods.description: Ensures unsigned jar files throw a SigningException.

methods.name: testInvalid
methods.description: Tests verification failure on invalid jar files.

methods.name: testWrongEntry
methods.description: Checks for failure when jar contains wrong entries.

methods.name: testMD5Digest
methods.description: Verifies that unsupported MD5 digest algorithms cause a SigningException.

methods.name: testMD5SignatureAlgo
methods.description: Ensures unsupported MD5 signature algorithms cause a SigningException.
